info.title: VerdictAI: Frictionless Dispute & Chargeback Resolution
info.description:
# ⚖️ VerdictAI REST API Gateway
    **Frictionless Dispute & Chargeback Resolution Platform**
    
    *Engineered for Card Members (Mobile), Merchants (Web), and Dispute-Ops Analysts/Admins (Web).*
    
    ### API Capabilities:
    * **Dispute Lifecycle Operations:** Case file creation, query filtering, state machine transitions.
    * **Polymorphic Evidence Storage:** Ingestion of binary documents (PDF/JPG/PNG) & structured JSON with SHA-256 integrity hashes.
    * **Dispute-Ops Admin Queue:** Filterable review queue & audited manual overrides.
    * **Cryptographic Audit Engine:** Tamper-evident hash-chained logs.

get.description: Returns real-time system operational metrics and active case counts.
Fetch all cardholder transactions eligible for dispute challenge (SRS FR-06).

get.description: Fetch a single transaction record by its unique ID.

post.description:
Creates a new cardholder dispute case file, registers transaction records,
calculates SLA deadlines, and establishes the cryptographic audit trail (SRS FR-06, FR-09, UC-01).

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of unified case files with multi-criteria filtering (SRS FR-22, FR-25).

get.description:
Retrieves the complete, tamper-evident case file combining PostgreSQL transactional data
and MongoDB polymorphic evidence items (SRS FR-26, SIR-01).

patch.description: Validates and performs deterministic state transitions across the dispute lifecycle (SRS FR-30, FR-32).

get.description: Returns the full audit log chain and cryptographic integrity verification status (SRS FR-21, FR-32).

post.summary: Evaluate dispute using Fair-Weighing ML Model (SIR-07, FR-15, UC-03)
post.description:
Synchronous ML inference endpoint per SRS SIR-07 and UC-03.
Evaluates evidence against the calibrated category rubric, produces confidence score,
recommendation, and plain-language explanation, automatically advances lifecycle state,
persists resolution, and logs model version and factor weights in the audit chain.

get.summary: Get AI scoring resolution details (FR-18, FR-21)
get.description: Retrieves the persisted resolution record, factor breakdown, and justification summary.

post.description:
Ingests binary evidence files (invoices, carrier tracking receipts, chat logs),
enforces file size limits (10MB for cardholders, 25MB for merchants),
computes deterministic SHA-256 hash checksums, and updates MongoDB case record (SRS FR-08, FR-14, AC-04).
Attaches structured carrier tracking telemetry, invoice details, or communication transcripts (SRS FR-11, FR-12).
Attaches or updates the cardholder narrative statement or merchant response statement.

get.summary: List all evidence items for a dispute
get.description: Retrieves all attached evidence payload models stored in MongoDB for the dispute.

schema.title: Response List Dispute Evidence Api V1 Evidence  Dispute Id  Items Get

get.description: Returns prioritized cases requiring human oversight (confidence < 50% or explicit escalation) (SRS FR-17, FR-25, US-AD-01).

post.summary: Manual decision override with mandatory audit reasoning
post.description:
Executes a manual admin override on an automated or flagged decision.
Enforces mandatory written justification per SRS FR-27 and AC-13.

post.summary: Assign dispute to an operations analyst
post.description: Assigns a dispute case to a specific Dispute-Ops analyst (SRS FR-28).

get.description: Generates downloadable compliance and audit summary covering decisions, overrides, and timelines (SRS FR-29, AC-15).

get.summary: Get Reasoning Engine status and guardrail capabilities
get.description:
Returns runtime operational capabilities, active model provider (Google Gemini 2.0 Flash XAI
vs Deterministic Safe Fallback), and configured hallucination guardrail verification rules.

post.summary: Generate explainable reasoning from scoring factors
post.description:
Direct inference endpoint generating transparent plain-language rationales
(cardholder, merchant, and objective summary) for arbitrary dispute scoring payloads.
All outputs are deterministically audited by HallucinationGuardrail before dispatch.

post.summary: Generate and persist reasoning for an existing dispute case
post.description:
Generates, audits, and persists explainable reasoning for an existing dispute case.
Coordinates between CaseService, FairWeighingScoringService, and PostgreSQL audit chain.

get.summary: Retrieve stored reasoning for a dispute case
get.description:
Retrieves previously evaluated explainable reasoning, factor breakdown, and

post.summary: Audit plain-language text against policy guardrails (PII, settlement promises, bias)
post.description:
Pre-submission audit endpoint enabling web (e.g. Admin override textarea) and mobile clients
to audit narrative justification text against strict policy rules prior to persistent storage.
Enforces PII redaction, prohibits unauthorized settlement promises, and detects adversarial bias.
